title: Dance and Movement
strapline: Moving to music — expression, rhythm and whole-body joy.
intent: Moving to music develops rhythm, coordination and control of the whole body.
Dance is a way to express feelings and ideas without needing words.
Copying, leading and inventing movements builds confidence and creativity.
Fast, slow, high, low and still bring rich movement and language together.
Dancing together builds a warm sense of belonging and shared fun.
implementation: Offer a range of music — different tempos, moods and cultures — and space to move safely.
Model moving expressively yourself; children copy adults who join in with abandon.
Play with contrasts: fast/slow, high/low, big/small, stamping/tiptoeing, moving/freezing.
Give children ribbons, scarves or streamers to extend and shape their movement.
Invite children to lead — "show us your move and we'll copy" — and value every idea.
Link movement to stories and feelings: "move like the storm", "dance how happy feels".
key_questions: How does this music make you want to move?
Can you move up high and down low?
Can you lead a move for us all to copy?
How would you dance a happy feeling? A cross one?
What happens to your body when the music stops?

impact.text: Children move with control, rhythm and confidence to a range of music.
Children express feelings and ideas through movement.
Children invent and lead their own movements and copy others'.
Children respond to fast/slow, high/low and stop/go with their bodies.
Children dance together and share in the joy of moving as a group.

enhancements: A speaker and a varied playlist across tempos, moods and cultures.
Ribbons, scarves and streamers to extend movement.
A large mirror so children can watch their own movement.
Simple percussion for children to move to their own beat.
Story or feeling prompt cards to inspire movement.
A clear, safe space that can be opened up for big movement.

playing_exploring: Children move freely and expressively, exploring what their bodies can do to music.
active_learning: Children keep dancing and refine their moves as they gain confidence.
creating_thinking: Children invent movements and connect them to feelings, stories and the music.
